name: list_tables
title: List tables
description: Lists the tables in the public schema with their row estimates. Use this when you do not yet know the table names.

name: describe_table
title: Describe table
description: Returns the columns, types and indexes of one table. Use this before writing a query against it.

name: query
title: Run read-only query
description: Runs a read-only SQL query inside a read-only transaction and returns at most 500 rows. Use this when you need data the other tools do not return.
